description: Connect a cloud or sandbox Agent to Alibaba Cloud Agent Data Gateway (Dgate) through its managed MCP service, or install/reinstall the Dgate CLI and its local Agent Skill/Rule bundle on macOS, Linux, or Windows. Use when the user asks to configure a Region-bound Dgate MCP endpoint and AccessToken, set up Dgate without installing a binary, install the dgate command, refresh the bundled dgate-cli skills, or verify either access path.
